messages.content: What is the VAT amount in 250 € including 25.5 % VAT?

For a price of 250,00 € including 25,5 % VAT, the VAT amount is 50,80 € (the tax-free price is 199,20 €).

To record your sales or expenses, you can create a new invoice here: /laskut/uusi
